subject.title: macOS launchd Gateway still restarts via gateway-update/update.run; document and honor auto-update kill-switch

question: Should `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` also suppress explicit Gateway control-plane `update.run` managed-service handoffs on supervised installs, or should it remain limited to configured background auto-update applies?
rationale: The current docs and code define the env var for automatic applies, while this issue asks to broaden it to an explicit update action that can be user- or control-plane-initiated; automation cannot choose that product contract safely.

options.title: Broaden kill-switch to update.run
options.body: Treat `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` as an operator-level block for managed `update.run` handoffs before restart scheduling, with tests/docs for launchd and background auto-update behavior.

options.title: Keep env scoped to auto-update
options.body: Document that `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE` only blocks configured background applies and handle no-op/launchd handoff reliability through the broader update-run issue.

options.title: Add a separate explicit control knob
options.body: Keep the current env behavior and introduce a new documented operator policy for control-plane update execution after security and compatibility review.

recommendation.title: Broaden kill-switch to update.run
recommendation.body: Treat `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` as an operator-level block for managed `update.run` handoffs before restart scheduling, with tests/docs for launchd and background auto-update behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc introduced the existing kill-switch contract and has recent updater history, making this the best available owner for the scope decision.
